articles.title: MSCI approves rules that could eject Strategy, Metaplanet from equity indexes
articles.snippet: The rules proposed in August would see companies that exist mainly to hold investments as no longer eligible for index inclusion.

articles.title: MSCI adopts index exclusion rules that could oust Strategy
articles.snippet: Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi were previously identified for deletion under the methodology, with MSCI set to announce its final list on Nov. 11.

articles.title: Zcash Tanks Double Digits After 'Meteoric Rise' Sees Leverage Build Up
articles.snippet: Experts blame a build up in leverage for Zcash's drop in value, as well as growing concerns about AI breaking crypto encryption.
